subject: Rosie O'Donnell to Release Epstein Victims Interview Series
posts:
Rosie O'Donnell to release Epstein survivor series after ABC pushback.
Evidence: Network rejection, Instagram video, survivor interviews
#Aletheia #Media

Rosie O'Donnell claims ABC blocked her Epstein survivor segment on Jimmy Kimmel Live, prompting her to produce an independent interview series.
Stated Judgement: (+0.7, +0.4) — Good Preference

The dispute blends genuine survivor advocacy with polarizing political posturing and independent media branding against institutional gatekeepers.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.5, -0.6) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
Trauma advocacy is co-opted into partisan grievances and self-promotional media friction.

Integrity: Partially Distorted (Hypocrisy: 4.5, z: 4)

Sub-Audits Breakdown:
- Rosie O'Donnell: FAIL (-0.5, -0.6) — Blends trauma with partisan jabs.
- ABC Network: COND (0.0, 0.0) — Standard editorial risk management.
Rosie O'Donnell revealed that ABC rejected her pitch featuring Jeffrey Epstein survivors during her guest-hosting stint on Jimmy Kimmel Live.

The Poison:
Framing standard broadcast editorial rejection as a deep conspiracy trivializes the genuine tragedy of Epstein survivors for political clout.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The plane error confuses WHO (survivors' voices) with WHAT (network programming control), weaponizing tragedy to settle scores with media gatekeepers.

Social Physics Analysis:
O'Donnell executes a Smart Selfish maneuver, leveraging survivor trauma as a pretext to project blame onto institutional enemies while burnishing independent clout.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated survivor support and partisan grandstanding, it plots a direct trajectory toward Deception. Advocacy becomes a vehicle for personal grievances.

The Unavoidable Truth: Epstein survivors deserve uncensored platforms to share their stories.

The Unavoidable Lie: Network scheduling decisions are part of a targeted censorship conspiracy.

Alethekanon:
Trauma is commodified into a political weapon, masking personal grievances behind the noble shield of survivor advocacy.

Awwthekanon:
These brave survivors deserve a space for healing and truth, free from being caught in the crossfire of celebrity feuds and media politics.

Brothekanon:
Classic Hollywood drama. Turn a serious tragedy into a network beef so everyone looks at your new YouTube project.

Spirithekanon:

True healing honors the dignity of the wounded rather than turning trauma into a spectacle.
